about: I am a software developer that loves building both user interfaces and server backends. During my learning journey, I met and conquered several hurdles, which helped me gain significant experience and enhance my skills.

projects.name: University Selection Platform
projects.description: Built full-stack platform with Next.js (App Router) and React featuring role-based dashboards for students, universities, and MOE admins, coupled with a cross-platform React Native/Expo mobile app for placement tracking.

projects.name: AddToCare — Women Empowerment Platform
projects.description: Engineered full-stack platform with Next.js/React featuring a three-dashboard architecture (Company, Admin, User), revenue-sharing model via PostgreSQL transactions for atomic fund allocation, and real-time analytics.

projects.name: Internship Placement Platform
projects.description: Developed full-stack PHP/MySQL platform for students to search/apply for internships and companies to manage postings, featuring secure company dashboard and dynamic student search filters.

projects.name: Brokerage Management System
projects.description: Built comprehensive platform for real estate/insurance brokers using PHP/MySQL with role-based access control, client management module with full CRUD operations, and reporting dashboards.
